module.name: Live Observability Loki
module.description: Cloud-agnostic primitive: deploy a single-replica Grafana Loki log store as plain Kubernetes manifests (no Helm). Service name and port match Forge AI Gateway defaults (loki:3100). PoC retention — emptyDir storage, configurable retention hours. Receives log streams from live-observability-collector; queried by Forge AI Gateway ranking/filter features.

required.reason: The observability namespace must exist before Loki resources are created.

optional.name: observability_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where Loki is deployed. Must match the namespace created by live-observability-namespace. Forge auto-wires this from the upstream module output.

optional.name: loki_service_name
optional.description: Kubernetes Service name for Loki. Must match the Forge AI Gateway loki_service_name setting (PR #393 default: loki).

optional.name: loki_port
optional.description: Port on which Loki's HTTP API listens. Must match the Forge AI Gateway loki_port setting (PR #393 default: 3100).

optional.name: loki_retention_hours
optional.description: Loki chunk and index retention in hours. Default 24 (1 day) is suitable for PoC. Set to 168 (7 days) if you need a longer rolling window.

key_outputs.name: loki_endpoint
key_outputs.description: In-cluster Loki push URL (http://<svc>.<ns>.svc.cluster.local:<port>/loki/api/v1/push). Provided for documentation; downstream modules use loki_service_name and loki_port separately.

key_outputs.name: loki_service_name
key_outputs.description: Resolved Loki Kubernetes Service name. Consumed by live-observability-collector and live-observability-readiness.

key_outputs.name: loki_port
key_outputs.description: Resolved Loki HTTP port. Consumed by live-observability-collector and live-observability-readiness.

key_outputs.name: loki_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace where Loki is deployed. Consumed by live-observability-collector to construct the in-cluster DNS hostname.

key_outputs.name: loki_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output — true once Loki manifests have been applied and the Deployment has rolled out. Downstream collector module depends on this.
